log.text: Light Screen up on P1's side

decisions.rationale: Lead Tyranitar + Excadrill executes the core game plan: Sand Stream immediately overrides Pelipper's Drizzle rain, shutting down Swift Swim on Mega Swampert, while Excadrill at 280 Spe under Sand Rush outspeeds the entire opposing roster and threatens spread Rock Slide flinches plus Iron Head for Fairies. Tyranitar's Passho Berry cushions Water hits from the rain team. Back Gengar-Mega for Shadow Tag trapping and Thunderbolt OHKO on Pelipper, Sludge Bomb into Primarina, and Shadow Ball into Basculegion. Back Grimmsnarl for Prankster Taunt to shut down Whimsicott's priority Encore/Tailwind (Dark typing makes Grimmsnarl immune to opposing Prankster moves) and dual screens to protect frail sweepers; Spirit Break also softens Primarina's special attacks.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 lead: Tyranitar+Excadrill, backs Gengar-Mega+Grimmsnarl. Core plan: Sand Stream overrides rain, Excadrill Sand Rush outspeeds entire opponent roster at 280 Spe. Gengar-Mega Shadow Tag traps and removes Pelipper (TBolt 4x), threatens Primarina (Sludge Bomb) and Basculegion (Shadow Ball). Grimmsnarl immune to Whimsicott Prankster via Dark typing; Prankster Taunt shuts Encore/Tailwind. Opponent likely leads Pelipper+Whimsicott (Tailwind+rain) or Pelipper+Swampert (rain core). Watch for Basculegion Choice Scarf outspeeding non-sand mons; Mega Swampert Swift Swim only active if rain persists (sand overrides). Forretress Sturdy+Stealth Rock is a slow hazard setter—consider Taunt or pressure early.

decisions.rationale: Lead Pelipper and Swampert to immediately overwrite Tyranitar's sand with Drizzle, activate Swampert's Swift Swim upon Mega Evolution, and pressure Tyranitar and Excadrill. Bring Basculegion and Primarina in the back to clean up with Swift Swim/Choice Scarf and powerful rain-boosted water attacks.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Lead Pelipper + Swampert, back Basculegion + Primarina. Weather control against Tyranitar/Excadrill sand core is priority.

decisions.rationale: Excadrill outspeeds everything at 280 and Rock Slide hits both foes (SE on Pelipper, 30% flinch each). If Swampert flinches, no Earthquake. Tyranitar Protects to avoid Swampert Earthquake (44-66% to Tyranitar). Even if Swampert doesn't flinch and Earthquakes, Excadrill survives at 1 HP via Focus Sash and Tyranitar stays at 100%. This preserves the sand setter while dealing damage and rolling flinches on the fastest slot.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 lead: Tyranitar+Excadrill vs Pelipper+Swampert. Sand active (5 turns). Excadrill 280 Spe outspeeds entire opponent roster including under Tailwind. Swampert Earthquake is the primary threat: 44-66% to Tyranitar, 81-119% to Excadrill (Focus Sash saves). Pelipper attacks are weak in sand (Hurricane 0.5x, Weather Ball Rock 0.25x on Excadrill). Passho Berry on Tyranitar cuts Liquidation to 26-39%. Plan: keep Tyranitar alive to maintain sand; Excadrill is primary damage dealer. Gengar-Mega Shadow Tag in back for trapping. Grimmsnarl for Prankster screen/Taunt support. Watch for Basculegion Choice Scarf Aqua Jet priority on weakened Excadrill.

decisions.rationale: Pelipper sets Tailwind to flip speed control against Sand Rush Excadrill, while Mega Swampert uses Liquidation on Tyranitar to wash away the sand and activate Drizzle rain.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Lead Pelipper + Swampert against Tyranitar + Excadrill. Tailwind + Mega Swampert Drizzle/Rain setup.

decisions.rationale: Excadrill Rock Slide outspeeds everything: SE on 50% HP Pelipper (chance to KO) plus 30% flinch on Swampert. Tyranitar Thunder Wave on Swampert provides critical long-term speed control — after Tailwind ends, paralyzed Swampert (45-61 Spe) drops below Tyranitar (81), and 25% full para chance every turn is invaluable. Swampert moves before Tyranitar under Tailwind so TWave won't block this turn's attack, but even if Swampert Earthquakes, Tyranitar survives at 17-40% HP and Excadrill survives via Focus Sash. This play also maintains value if Pelipper Protects (unlike double Rock Slide which would be wasted). Paralyzing the opponent's Mega is the highest-value disruptive play available.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 lead: Tyranitar+Excadrill vs Pelipper+Swampert-Mega. Sand 4 turns left, foe Tailwind 3 turns left. Swampert-Mega Earthquake: 59.5-83.1% to Tyranitar (survives), guaranteed OHKO to Excadrill (Sash saves at 1 HP). Excadrill Rock Slide on Pelipper: 33.5-63.7% — may KO at 50% HP. Tyranitar Rock Slide on Pelipper: 40.7-77%. Passho Berry on Tyranitar cuts Liquidation to ~26-39%. Plan: Thunder Wave Swampert for long-term speed control (paralyzed Swampert under Tailwind = 90-122 Spe, still beats Tyranitar 81; after Tailwind expires = 45-61, loses to Tyranitar). Keep Tyranitar alive to maintain sand. Gengar-Mega Shadow Tag in back for trapping. Grimmsnarl for Prankster screens/Taunt. Watch for Basculegion Scarf Aqua Jet priority on 1 HP Excadrill. If Pelipper goes down, expect Basculegion/Primarina/Whimsicott/Forretress — only 2 of those 4 are in this game.

decisions.rationale: Excadrill fainted; bring Grimmsnarl for priority Reflect (Light Clay = 8 turns) to halve Swampert-Mega's physical attacks (Liquidation/EQ/Ice Punch) while Tyranitar still holds Passho Berry for the first Water hit. This keeps Tyranitar alive to maintain Sandstorm through the 3-turn Tailwind window. Gengar-Mega is better held for post-Tailwind cleanup with Shadow Tag trapping and superior Speed. Pelipper at 1% is trivially handled next turn by Rock Slide or Spirit Break.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Team is Tyranitar/Excadrill/Gengar/Grimmsnarl. Excadrill fainted turn 2 (Sash consumed). Thunder Wave on Swampert failed (Ground immunity). Passho Berry still on Tyranitar (never consumed). Foe Tailwind 3 turns left; Sand 4 turns left. Pelipper at 1%. Swampert-Mega at 79%, not paralyzed. Plan: Grimmsnarl priority Reflect to survive Tailwind window, then Gengar-Mega Shadow Tag cleanup once Tailwind expires. Watch for Scarf Basculegion Aqua Jet priority and Whimsicott Prankster (faster than Grimmsnarl in priority bracket). Only 2 of Basculegion/Primarina/Whimsicott/Forretress are in this game.

decisions.rationale: Swampert-Mega hits Excadrill or Tyranitar with Liquidation while Pelipper uses Hurricane on Excadrill or Tyranitar (or vice versa), securing heavy damage under Tailwind.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Sand Stream replaces Drizzle if Tyranitar is on field. Swampert-Mega and Pelipper outspeed under Tailwind.

decisions.rationale: Grimmsnarl Prankster Reflect goes up before Swampert attacks, cutting Earthquake to ~30-42% on Tyranitar (survivable at 100%) and ~20-27% on Grimmsnarl. Tyranitar then Rock Slides: guaranteed KO on 1% Pelipper even at spread 0.75x, 30% flinch chance on Swampert, and NVE chip on Swampert. Pelipper dies to Sandstorm if it doesn't Protect. Passho Berry still held for Liquidation insurance. This sets up for Gengar-Mega Shadow Tag cleanup once Tailwind expires after next turn.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Excadrill fainted turn 2 (Sash consumed). Thunder Wave on Swampert failed (Ground immunity). Passho Berry still on Tyranitar (never consumed). Reflect planned this turn (turn 3) via Grimmsnarl Prankster priority. Tailwind expires end of turn 4; Sandstorm expires end of turn 5 (3 turns left at start of turn 3). Plan: survive turn 3-4 under Tailwind with Reflect, then bring Gengar-Mega for Shadow Tag lockdown when Tailwind drops. Gengar-Mega raw Speed 165-200 outspeeds Swampert-Mega (90-122) and all revealed foes without Tailwind. Watch for Scarf Basculegion Aqua Jet priority and Whimsicott Prankster (faster than Grimmsnarl in priority bracket). Only 2 of Basculegion/Primarina/Whimsicott/Forretress are in this game.

decisions.rationale: Pelipper is at 2% HP and should protect to preserve presence or stall out Tailwind turns, while Swampert-Mega targets Grimmsnarl with Liquidation to pick up a secure neutral/heavy blow or eliminate Grimmsnarl before it can set up screens or disrupt.
decisions.notebook: Tyranitar carries Passho Berry and Sand Stream; Grimmsnarl carries Light Clay for dual screens.

decisions.rationale: Pelipper has fainted, so we send in Basculegion to clean up. Swampert-Mega passes its action (or we can use an attack, but here we just need to send in our replacement and take our next turn). Wait, Swampert-Mega's slot choice is Pass because Pelipper's slot is a switch choice. Let's make sure Basculegion comes in.

Focus-fire Basculegion to remove the Adaptability Choice Scarf threat. Tyranitar Crunch is SE (56-106%, possible OHKO) and Grimmsnarl Spirit Break adds 24-45%, combining for 80-151% plus Sandstorm chip — high KO probability if both land. Tyranitar survives a double-target with ~98% odds (Wave Crash 64-93 HP post-Passho+Reflect + Earthquake 77-108 HP post-Reflect+spread = 141-201 vs 195 HP). Even if one Pokémon falls, the other still chips Basculegion heavily, and Gengar-Mega enters next turn under Shadow Tag with Tailwind expired. Protecting Tyranitar would leave Basculegion at high HP, risking Gengar-Mega being outsped by Scarf Basculegion (147-195 vs 165-200) next turn — offensive focus-fire avoids that scenario entirely.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Excadrill fainted turn 2 (Sash consumed). Thunder Wave on Swampert failed (Ground immunity). Passho Berry still on Tyranitar (never consumed). Reflect up (turn 3). Tailwind expires end of turn 4; Sandstorm expires end of turn 5. Plan: KO or heavily chip Basculegion turn 4 via Crunch+Spirit Break focus fire, then bring Gengar-Mega turn 5 for Shadow Tag lockdown on Swampert+remaining foe. Gengar-Mega raw Speed 165-200 outspeeds Swampert-Mega (90-122) without Tailwind; vs Scarf Basculegion (147-195) it's a coinflip, so chipping/KOing Basculegion this turn is critical. Only 2 of Basculegion/Primarina/Whimsicott/Forretress are in this game; 4th foe unknown. Crunch has possible OHKO range on Basculegion (56-106%). Key damage refs: Wave Crash on Tyranitar 33-48% (post-Passho+Reflect), Earthquake on Tyranitar 40-55% (post-Reflect+spread), Earthquake on Grimmsnarl 26-37% (post-Reflect+spread).

decisions.rationale: Basculegion outspeeds and uses Wave Crash on Tyranitar, while Mega Swampert uses Liquidation on Tyranitar to secure the KO through its Passho Berry in Sand, ignoring Reflect since water hits hard and Tyranitar is the main offensive threat remaining.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Tyranitar)
decisions.rationale: Switch Tyranitar (3% HP, dead weight) to Gengar-Mega for Shadow Tag—trapping both foes is the highest-impact play. Grimmsnarl uses Light Screen via Prankster priority (guaranteed to resolve before opponent moves). Moonblast is a guaranteed KO on Grimmsnarl from 47% without screens; Light Screen cuts it to ~38-54%, giving survival chance vs single-target Moonblast and converting several double-target spread combos from guaranteed KO to possible survival. Even if Grimmsnarl dies, Light Screen persists 8 turns (Light Clay) to protect Gengar-Mega from Primarina's special attacks. Spirit Break lacks priority and likely won't resolve if Primarina outspeeds and KOs Grimmsnarl first. Dual screens + Shadow Tag = optimal sweep setup.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 turn 5: Switched Tyranitar→Gengar-Mega (Shadow Tag), Grimmsnarl used Light Screen (Prankster). Plan: Shadow Tag locks Swampert-Mega (38%, -1 SpA) + Primarina (100%) in place. Gengar-Mega outspeeds both (165-200 vs 90-122/80-112). Next turn: Gengar-Mega Shadow Ball on Swampert (neutral, chip toward KO) or Sludge Bomb/Thunderbolt on Primarina (both 2x SE). Grimmsnarl support: Spirit Break on Swampert to chip+lower SpA, or Taunt Primarina to block Protect. Key threat: Primarina Moonblast guaranteed KOs Grimmsnarl without Light Screen. Dual screens (Reflect 6 turns + Light Screen 8 turns) protect Gengar-Mega. Tyranitar at 3% in back (Rock/Dark immune to Sandstorm damage). 4th foe unknown (Whimsicott or Forretress not brought). Passho Berry was consumed (corrected from notebook).

decisions.rationale: Tyranitar is at 3% HP and needs to be cleaned up immediately, and Moonblast + Liquidation guarantees taking it down through Reflect while dealing strong damage to Grimmsnarl. Primarina's Moonblast on Tyranitar and Swampert's Liquidation on Tyranitar ensure no RNG from Rock Slide flinches or misses can save Tyranitar.
decisions.notebook: Tyranitar is at 3% HP and lacks its Passho Berry. Grimmsnarl set Reflect and has Light Clay remaining. Opponent's 4th Pokémon is unrevealed.

decisions.rationale: Gengar Mega Evolves and Sludge Bombs Primarina — Gengar outspeeds (178 vs 80-112), and Mega SpA boost (~238 vs 182) pushes Sludge Bomb from 58.8-104.5% to ~77-137%, making OHKO very likely. This is the only path to survival: if Primarina acts, Moonblast guaranteed KOs Grimmsnarl (50-72.2% from 47%) and any hit KOs Gengar at 3%. If Primarina falls, Swampert alone cannot KO Grimmsnarl (Liquidation max 41.8% < 47% HP), and Grimmsnarl's Spirit Break chips Swampert from 38% to ~5-19%, setting up an easy cleanup with Tyranitar. Grimmsnarl Spirit Break on Swampert is superior to Taunt (doesn't stop Moonblast) or refreshing screens (already active).
decisions.notebook: Opponent G1 brought: Pelipper (Drizzle/DampRock/Modest, fainted), Swampert-Mega (Swampertite/Adamant/Swift Swim, 38% HP, -1 SpA), Basculegion (ChoiceScarf/Adaptability/Adamant, fainted), Primarina (MysticWater/LiquidVoice/Modest, 100% HP). Did NOT bring Whimsicott (FocusSash/Prankster/Timid) or Forretress (SitrusBerry/Sturdy/Relaxed). My team: Tyranitar (Passho consumed/Careful/Sandstream, 3% HP), Excadrill (Focus Sash consumed/Adamant/Sandrush, fainted), Gengar (Gengarite/Timid/Cursed Body→Shadow Tag on Mega, 3% HP), Grimmsnarl (Light Clay/Careful/Prankster, 47% HP). Key damage benchmarks: Gengar Sludge Bomb on Primarina 58.8-104.5% regular, ~77-137% Mega (2x SE Poison vs Fairy). Primarina Moonblast on Grimmsnarl 50-72.2% (guaranteed KO from 47%). Swampert Liquidation on Grimmsnarl 29.4-41.8% (survives from 47% with Reflect). Grimmsnarl Spirit Break on Swampert 19.3-33.1% (neutral). Primarina Hyper Voice is Water-type via Liquid Voice. For G2: opponent may adjust bring to include Whimsicott (priority Tailwind/Encore) or Forretress (hazards/Gyro Ball). Consider leading Tyranitar+Excadrill again or adapting to their likely changes.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Swampert-Mega's Earthquake hits both Gengar (at 2% HP, guaranteed KO) and Grimmsnarl (at 46% HP), bypassing Reflect and Light Screen because Earthquake is a physical ground-type spread move. Primarina uses Moonblast into Grimmsnarl (foe 2) to pick up significant damage on Grimmsnarl, ensuring maximum board clearing.
decisions.notebook: Grimmsnarl has Reflect and Light Screen active. Gengar has 2% HP. Swampert-Mega's Earthquake deals spread damage that ignores screens and cleans up Gengar and chunks Grimmsnarl.

decisions.rationale: Both Pokémon attack Swampert-Mega at 5% HP — Crunch and Spirit Break are both guaranteed KOs. Swampert outspeeds both and every one of its attacks KOs both my Pokémon (Tyranitar 3%, Grimmsnarl 16%) even through Reflect. Earthquake (spread) KOs both simultaneously and is the opponent's optimal play, which I cannot stop. However, if the opponent uses ANY single-target move instead, one of my Pokémon survives and KOs Swampert — I win. By not Protecting (when the opponent likely expects Tyranitar to Protect at 3%), I bait a potential single-target misread. Protect-based lines are strictly worse: double Protect only delays the Earthquake KO by one turn, and Tyranitar Protect + Grimmsnarl Spirit Break loses to both Earthquake and Liquidation targeting Grimmsnarl.
decisions.notebook: Opponent G1 brought: Pelipper (Drizzle/DampRock/Modest, fainted), Swampert-Mega (Swampertite/Adamant/Swift Swim, fainted G1), Basculegion (ChoiceScarf/Adaptability/Adamant, fainted), Primarina (MysticWater/LiquidVoice/Modest, fainted). Did NOT bring: Whimsicott (FocusSash/Prankster/Timid, priority Tailwind/Encore) or Forretress (SitrusBerry/Sturdy/Relaxed, GyroBall/BodyPress/StealthRock). My team: Tyranitar (Passho Berry/Careful/Sandstream), Excadrill (Focus Sash/Adamant/Sandrush), Gengar-Mega (Gengarite/Timid/Shadow Tag), Grimmsnarl (Light Clay/Careful/Prankster). Key G1 damage benchmarks: Gengar Sludge Bomb 2HKO-KO range on Primarina (SE Poison vs Fairy); Primarina Moonblast OHKOs Grimmsnarl from 47%; Swampert Liquidation 29-42% on Grimmsnarl through Reflect (OHKOs from 16%); Swampert Earthquake 26-37% on Grimmsnarl through Reflect+spread (OHKOs from 16%); Grimmsnarl Spirit Break 19-33% on Swampert (neutral); Tyranitar Crunch 22-39% on Swampert (neutral). G2 plan: opponent likely adjusts bring — watch for Whimsicott (priority Encore locks Tyranitar/Excadrill into Rock Slide/EQ, Tailwind speed control) or Forretress (Stealth Rock chip, Gyro Ball hits Excadrill/Grimmsnarl). Consider leading Tyranitar+Excadrill again for sand rush pressure, or Gengar+Grimmsnarl if expecting Whimsicott lead (Taunt shuts Encore/Tailwind). If opponent keeps rain core, Passho Tyranitar + Sand Rush Excadrill remains strong into Pelipper/Swampert. Gengar-Mega Shadow Ball traps and KOs Basculegion; Sludge Bomb is primary answer to Primarina.

decisions.rationale: Swampert-Mega's Earthquake hits both Tyranitar (3%) and Grimmsnarl (15%) for super-effective / normal spread damage that ignores Reflect and Light Screen, guaranteeing KOs on both low-HP foes to close out Game 1. Primarina is fainted and must pass.
decisions.notebook: Swampert-Mega clinched Game 1 with Earthquake bypassing screens.

reflections.summary: Lost because Swampert-Mega under rain/Tailwind outsped and swept after Excadrill died on turn 2. Thunder Wave on Swampert was wasted (Ground immunity), losing a critical turn of damage. Without Sand Rush speed control, nothing could outspeed Swampert, and its spread Earthquake cleaned up the weakened endgame positions on turns 6-7. Gengar-Mega traded with Primarina but fell to Swampert EQ same turn, leaving no answer to Swampert at 5%.
reflections.adjustment: Do not target Swampert with Thunder Wave (Ground-immune). Prioritize keeping Excadrill alive longer — consider Protect on turn 2 instead of trading into Swampert+Pelipper under Tailwind. Need a cleaner Swampert answer: focus chip from Tyranitar Crunch + Grimmsnarl Spirit Break earlier rather than splitting damage across Pelipper. If Swampert reaches low HP with EQ access, avoid both Pokémon being EQ-vulnerable simultaneously.
reflections.notebook: Opponent G1 brought: Pelipper (Drizzle/DampRock/Modest), Swampert-Mega (Swampertite/Adamant/Swift Swim, uses Liquidation + Earthquake spread), Basculegion (ChoiceScarf/Adaptability/Adamant, Wave Crash/FlipTurn/AquaJet), Primarina (MysticWater/LiquidVoice/Modest, HyperVoice/Moonblast/IcyWind). Did NOT bring: Whimsicott (FocusSash/Prankster/Timid, priority Tailwind/Encore) or Forretress (SitrusBerry/Sturdy/Relaxed, GyroBall/BodyPress/StealthRock). CRITICAL: Thunder Wave is useless on Swampert (Water/Ground immunity) — never attempt it. Swampert-Mega uses Earthquake as spread move in endgame; avoid fielding two EQ-vulnerable Pokémon when Swampert is active at low HP. Excadrill is the only Sand Rush speed answer to Swift Swim Swampert — preserving it is essential. Swampert Liquidation ~40% on Grimmsnarl through Reflect; Earthquake spread ~26% on Grimmsnarl through Reflect. Gengar-Mega Sludge Bomb OHKOs Primarina after chip (SE Poison). Basculegion Choice Scarf outspeeds Tyranitar; Wave Crash does ~41% to Tyranitar (Passho consumed). G2 plan: opponent may adjust to Whimsicott (priority Encore/Tailwind) or Forretress (Stealth Rock/Gyro Ball). If rain core returns, lead Tyranitar+Excadrill but Protect Excadrill turn 1-2 to preserve Sand Rush answer for Swampert. Gengar+Grimmsnarl lead if expecting Whimsicott (Taunt shuts Encore/Tailwind). Gengar-Mega Shadow Tag traps Basculegion/Primarina; Sludge Bomb is primary Primarina answer.

reflections.summary: Swampert-Mega and Pelipper established early offensive pressure under Tailwind to remove Excadrill, allowing Swampert to clean up with Earthquake through opponent's screens in the endgames.
reflections.adjustment: Retain Pelipper and Swampert-Mega as core leads to counter the opponent's weather setters and dual screens setup.
reflections.notebook: Opponent leads Tyranitar and Excadrill with backline Grimmsnarl and Mega Gengar. Uses dual screens and Prankster support.
